overview: Nightly claims batch. CLMD100 sorts the claim master, prices each claim (CLMB200, with CLMB210), posts payments to DB2 (CLMB300) and sends the extract to Finance by Connect:Direct. CLMD300 runs the payment feed (CLMPRC, CLMB400). DATEUTIL is assembler and is not analysed.
